content.introduction: The US stock market sectors include Technology Services, Finance, Utilities, Industrial Services, and Transportation. The S&P 500 sectors are Consumer Discretionary, Consumer Staples, Health Care, Industrials, Materials, and Real Estate. The market sectors' performance varies daily.
